product_flow.name: Photographic plates and film, exposed and developed, other than cinematographic film

non-cinematographic still negative and actual optical exposure/custody
complete purchased unexposed film and supplier boundary
actual image/strip identifiers and retained versus removed leaders/samples

whole supplied concentrate batches and actual dilution water
measured time/temperature/agitation and bath carryover/history
fixing/washing/drying and negative quality specification
net film weighing method and conditioning state
unique first-release Q and original cohort Qc
opening/closing raw WIP non-WIP FG and exchange vectors
actual post-release services and observation horizon H
actual utilities and supplier geography/delivery basis
each packaging article and its complete custody pool
wet waste mass and actual phase/composition/silver species/destination
sampling coverage and detection/uncertainty
actual equipment-use and external transport/treatment links
attributional allocation evidence and unassigned burdens
